input.summary: Add Customer 30-day convenience termination right and bar Vendor convenience termination; conform take-or-pay clause
input.comment: [Playbook] We need a convenience exit: we have added a Customer right to terminate on thirty days' written notice (with the existing Section 10.2 pro-rata refund of prepaid Fees applying) and confirmed Vendor has no convenience right during a committed term. We also conformed the take-or-pay sentence in Section 2.1, which otherwise denies us any termination right, while leaving the no-reduction restriction intact.

ops.oldText: on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
ops.newText: on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction rights but subject to Section 9.4.

ops.text: Customer may terminate this Agreement or any Order Form for convenience upon thirty days' prior written notice to Vendor. Vendor has no right to terminate this Agreement or any Order Form for convenience during a committed term.
